# Pujo Pandal — Siliguri Durga Puja 2026 guide

> Pujo Pandal (https://durgapujapandal.site) is a free, independent guide to Durga Puja in Siliguri, West Bengal, India. It maps 83 community Durga Puja pandals across 28 Siliguri neighbourhoods for 2026, with a smart pandal-hopping route planner, the festival schedule and local guides.

Key facts:
- Durga Puja 2026 in Siliguri runs from Maha Shashti (Saturday, 17 October 2026) to Bijoya Dashami (Wednesday, 21 October 2026). Mahalaya is on Saturday, 10 October 2026.
- 83 pandals: 28 theme, 18 traditional, 19 heritage, 14 community and 4 eco-friendly pujas; 38 have parking nearby.
- Busiest evenings: Ashtami and Navami, especially around Hill Cart Road, Sevoke Road and Venus More from 7 PM to midnight.
- Contact: pujopandal@gmail.com · Collegepara, Siliguri, West Bengal 734005.

# Durga Puja 2026 dates (Siliguri, West Bengal)
- Mahalaya: Saturday, 10 October 2026 — Invocation of Goddess Durga with dawn Chandi Path and Tarpan at Mahananda Ghat.
- Maha Shashti: Saturday, 17 October 2026 — Beginning of Devi worship with Kalparambha, Bodhan, Amantran and Adhibas.
- Maha Saptami: Sunday, 18 October 2026 — Nabapatrika Pravesh (Kola Bou Snan) at river ghats followed by Saptami Puja rituals.
- Maha Ashtami: Monday, 19 October 2026 — Morning Pushpanjali, Kumari Puja, and the sacred 48-minute Sandhi Puja transition into Navami.
- Maha Navami: Tuesday, 20 October 2026 — Navami Homa, Bhog distribution, and evening Dhunuchi dance aratis.
- Vijaya Dashami: Wednesday, 21 October 2026 — Aparajita Puja, Sindoor Khela, and Visarjan processions at Mahananda River Ghats.

# All 83 Siliguri Durga Puja pandals (2026), highest score first
### Central Colony Durga Puja Committee
- Page: https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/central-colony-durga-puja-committee
- Area: Central Colony (North Siliguri), Siliguri
- Venue 2026: Barrack Colony Ground adjacent to NJP Police Station
- Style: Theme · Theme 2026: Grand Architectural Splendor (64th Year Edition)
- Pandal score: 9.6/10 · Visit time: ~50 min
- Parking: available — Spacious open ground parking available adjacent to Barrack Colony field.
- Access: Broad transit access from Burdwan Road and NJP Railway link road.
- GPS: 26.6828357, 88.424336
- One of Siliguri's largest and most iconic pujas, relocated for 2026 to the expansive Barrack Colony Ground near NJP Police Station. Famous for colossal architectural pandals, an extensive festive fairground (mela), and magnificent lighting displays.

### Hakimpara Yuvak Sangha
- Page: https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/hakimpara-yuvak-sangha
- Area: Hakimpara (Central Siliguri), Siliguri
- Venue 2026: Hakimpara Yuvak Sangha Ground, Ward 15
- Style: Traditional · Theme 2026: Sabeki Ekchala Traditional Rajbari Pujo
- Pandal score: 9.6/10 · Visit time: ~35 min
- Parking: walk-in only — Strictly walk-in; no vehicular entry into Babu Chhatra lane.
- Access: Walkable from Church Road and Panitanki More.
- GPS: 26.71852, 88.42814
- Steeped in aristocrat heritage, Hakimpara Yuvak Sangha features a resplendent Ekchala Pratima crafted in timeless Daaker Saaj, accompanied by continuous dhak recitals and traditional evening aarti that draw devotees seeking authentic devotion.

### Shaktigarh Sarbajanin Durga Utsav
- Page: https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/shaktigarh-sarbajanin-durga-utsav
- Area: Shaktigarh (South Siliguri), Siliguri
- Venue 2026: Shaktigarh High School Ground / Main Road, Ward 31
- Style: Theme · Theme 2026: Uttareshwar (Hawa Mahal-inspired architecture)
- Pandal score: 9.6/10 · Visit time: ~50 min
- Parking: available — Designated ground parking; traffic police diversions active along Shaktigarh Main Road.
- Access: Well-marked pedestrian and vehicular lanes from Burdwan Road.
- GPS: 26.7025, 88.4285
- Celebrating its historic 75th year milestone edition, Shaktigarh Sarbajanin is an undisputed megastar of Siliguri Durga Puja. Features a monumental Hawa Mahal architectural replica, spectacular laser light presentations, and an expansive festive fairground.

# Curated routes
## Central Siliguri Heritage & Traditional Loop
https://durgapujapandal.site/routes/central-siliguri-heritage-walk
Walking · A classic heritage circuit through the traditional bastions of Central Siliguri, covering Sabeki idols, century-old clubs, and intimate neighborhood celebrations.
Stops: Ujjwal Sangha → Hakimpara Yuvak Sangha → Dada Bhai Sporting Club → Jatiya Tarun Sangha
Tips:
- Best experienced on foot or by cycle between 4:00 PM and 8:00 PM before peak evening rush.
- Enjoy authentic Siliguri street snacks like Ghugni and Jhalmuri around Deshbandhupara crossing.
- Strict no-vehicle zones apply inside residential alleys of Hakimpara.

## Eastern Corridor Grand Theme Tour
https://durgapujapandal.site/routes/eastern-corridor-grand-themes
Bike / Scooty · Witness Siliguri’s most breathtaking blockbuster theme pandals along the eastern artery and Sevoke Road corridor, featuring monumental structures and laser illuminations.
Stops: Haiderpara Sporting Club → Salugara Durga Puja Committee → Baghajatin Park Durgotsab Committee
Tips:
- Take two-wheelers or battery e-rickshaws (Toto) as car parking along Sevoke Road is restricted.
- Peak illumination lighting starts after 6:30 PM.
- Check police diversions near Panitanki traffic point before entering Haiderpara.

## North Junction Accessible Family Express
https://durgapujapandal.site/routes/north-junction-family-express
Car / Auto · Designed specifically for families with elders and young children, focusing on wide approach roads, designated parking hubs, and easy pedestrian walkways.
Stops: Champasari Milan Sangha → Uttar Mallaguri Sarbojanin Durga Puja Committee → Shiv Mandir Durga Puja Committee
Tips:
- Dedicated parking grounds available near Champasari High School grounds.
- Wheelchair friendly entrance corridors available at Uttar Mallaguri.
- Ideal time for family visits is late morning (11 AM - 3 PM) or early dusk.

# Guides
## Durga Puja Pandal Map 2026: Every Siliguri Pandal on One Map
https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/durga-puja-pandal-map-2026 · Updated 2026-10-09 · Pujo Pandal Siliguri Desk

All 83 Siliguri pandals on one map — GPS pins, zones, parking notes, top-rated pujas and how to plan your evenings around them.

Planning to go pandal hopping this Sharat? The **Durga Puja pandal map 2026** for Siliguri puts all 83 verified pandals on one screen — with GPS pins, neighbourhood zones, parking notes and realistic travel times. This guide explains what is on the map, how it is organised, and how to use it to see more pandals while spending less time stuck on the road.

- Pandals on the map: 83
- Neighbourhoods: 28
- Pandals with parking: 38
- Main Pujo days: 17–21 Oct 2026
- Cost: Free, no app needed

[Open the live pandal map](https://durgapujapandal.site/siliguri-puja-map)

## What is on the Durga Puja pandal map 2026

- **83 pandals across 28 neighbourhoods**, each pinned at its 2026 venue rather than the centre of the locality.
- A **pandal score**, theme, estimated visit time and parking status for every pin.
- Quick filters for **theme pujas, traditional pujas, verified records and parking**.
- One-tap **Google Maps directions** from wherever you are standing.
- A [smart route planner](https://durgapujapandal.site/siliguri-puja-routes) that turns pins into an ordered plan for your evening.

Pins use entrance coordinates checked for 2026. That matters when a committee shifts grounds — Central Colony, for example, now uses the Barrack Colony venue — because a pin dropped on the old locality centre can send you to the wrong lane in a crowd.

## How the map is organised: five zones

Siliguri’s pujas fall into five practical zones. Hopping inside one zone per evening is the single best way to cut travel time, because crossing the city during peak hours can take longer than the visits themselves.

| Zone | Pandals | With parking |
|---|---|---|
| Central Siliguri | 43 | 6 |
| South & South-Central | 13 | 7 |
| East & Sevoke Road corridor | 12 | 11 |
| North Siliguri | 5 | 5 |
| West, Junction & Rajganj | 10 | 9 |

For full lists of each zone, read the [zone-wise Siliguri pandal map](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/siliguri-durga-puja-pandal-map-2026-zone-wise).

4. [Babupara Sarbojanin Durga Puja](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/babupara-club-sarbojanin) — Babupara, Theme, score 9.5; theme “Terracotta Echoes of Bengal — Architectural Heritage”

## Pandals by style

- **28 theme pandals** — large concept installations and lighting. See the [best theme pandals on the map](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/best-theme-pandals-durga-puja-pandal-map-2026).
- **19 heritage pandals** — temple, palace and terracotta-inspired architecture.
- **18 traditional pujas** — ekchala pratima, daaker saaj and classic rituals. See [traditional & heritage pujas](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/traditional-heritage-pujas-durga-puja-pandal-map-2026).
- **14 community pujas** — neighbourhood paras with a warm, local feel.
- **4 eco-friendly pandals** — bamboo, jute, clay and natural materials.

## Walking, bike or car?

| Travel mode | Best for | Practical range per evening |
|---|---|---|
| Walking | Dense clusters like Babupara, Hakimpara, Deshbandhupara | About 2–3 km of walking |
| Bike / scooty | Jumping between zones, Sevoke Road corridor | Up to about 8 km |
| Car / auto | Families, elders, outer pujas with parking | Up to about 10 km, start early |

Many top pandals are walk-in only. Before you drive, check the [pandal map with parking](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/durga-puja-pandal-map-2026-bike-car-parking) — 38 pandals list parking near the venue this year.

## Durga Puja 2026 dates at a glance

- Mahalaya: Saturday, 10 October 2026 — Invocation of Goddess Durga with dawn Chandi Path and Tarpan at Mahananda Ghat.
- Maha Shashti: Saturday, 17 October 2026 — Beginning of Devi worship with Kalparambha, Bodhan, Amantran and Adhibas.
- Maha Saptami: Sunday, 18 October 2026 — Nabapatrika Pravesh (Kola Bou Snan) at river ghats followed by Saptami Puja rituals.
- Maha Ashtami: Monday, 19 October 2026 — Morning Pushpanjali, Kumari Puja, and the sacred 48-minute Sandhi Puja transition into Navami.
- Maha Navami: Tuesday, 20 October 2026 — Navami Homa, Bhog distribution, and evening Dhunuchi dance aratis.
- Vijaya Dashami: Wednesday, 21 October 2026 — Aparajita Puja, Sindoor Khela, and Visarjan processions at Mahananda River Ghats.

For a day-by-day plan that matches pandals to rituals, read [Durga Puja 2026 dates & pandal map](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/durga-puja-2026-dates-pandal-map-day-wise-plan).

## Tips for using the pandal map during Pujo

- Start before 6 PM. Roads around Venus More, Hill Cart Road and Sevoke Road fill up fast after dark.
- Save pandals in advance with the bookmark icon so your list is ready on your phone.
- Download Siliguri for offline use in Google Maps in case mobile data slows down in crowds.
- Share your live location with your group and fix a meeting point near a landmark.
- Keep small change for totos and autos, and check traffic advisories from the Siliguri Metropolitan Police before you leave.

[Build my Puja route](https://durgapujapandal.site/siliguri-puja-routes)

### FAQs
**Is the Durga Puja pandal map 2026 free to use?**
Yes. The Siliguri Durga Puja pandal map 2026 is completely free — no sign-up or app download is needed. It works in any phone browser.

**How many pandals are on the Siliguri Durga Puja pandal map 2026?**
The map currently lists 83 verified pandals across 28 neighbourhoods of Siliguri, each pinned at its 2026 venue.

**Does the pandal map work without internet?**
The live map needs mobile data to load. Save the pandals you want, and download Siliguri as an offline area in Google Maps so directions keep working if the network slows down in crowds.

**Can I get directions to a pandal from the map?**
Yes. Tap any pin and choose Directions — Google Maps opens with that pandal as your destination.

**When is Durga Puja 2026 in Siliguri?**
Mahalaya falls on 10 October 2026. The main Pujo days run from Maha Shashti on 17 October to Vijaya Dashami on 21 October 2026.

## Siliguri Durga Puja Pandal Map 2026: Zone-Wise Pandal List
https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/siliguri-durga-puja-pandal-map-2026-zone-wise · Updated 2026-10-09 · Pujo Pandal Siliguri Desk

Siliguri’s pandals split into five zones. Here is every zone with its top pandals, a map and how to cover it in one evening.

The fastest way to use the **Durga Puja pandal map 2026** is zone by zone. Siliguri’s 83 pandals cluster into five areas, and staying inside one of them for an evening saves you the slowest part of Pujo — crossing the city at peak hour.

- Zones: 5
- Busiest zone: Central Siliguri
- Best plan: 1–2 zones per evening
- Pandals covered: 83

| Zone | Pandals | With parking |
|---|---|---|
| Central Siliguri | 43 | 6 |
| South & South-Central | 13 | 7 |
| East & Sevoke Road corridor | 12 | 11 |
| North Siliguri | 5 | 5 |
| West, Junction & Rajganj | 10 | 9 |

## Central Siliguri: the densest zone

Babupara, Hakimpara, Mahananda Para, Ashrampara and the Hill Cart Road belt hold the biggest share of pujas. Dozens of pandals sit within a short walk of each other, so leave the vehicle outside and go on foot.

1. [Hakimpara Yuvak Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/hakimpara-yuvak-sangha) — Hakimpara, Traditional, score 9.6; theme “Sabeki Ekchala Traditional Rajbari Pujo”
2. [Babupara Sarbojanin Durga Puja](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/babupara-club-sarbojanin) — Babupara, Theme, score 9.5; theme “Terracotta Echoes of Bengal — Architectural Heritage”
3. [Babupara YMA Club](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/babupara-yma-club) — Babupara, Theme, score 9.4; theme “Grand Heritage Architecture & Palace Replicas”
4. [Jatiya Tarun Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/jatiya-tarun-sangha) — Ashrampara, Theme, score 9.4; theme “Illumination Wonders & Contemporary Art”
5. [Rabindra Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/rabindra-sangha) — Hakimpara, Heritage, score 9.4; theme “Tagore's Shantiniketan Aesthetic & Cultural Harmony”
6. [Baghajatin Park Durgotsab Committee](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/baghajatin-park-durgotsab-committee) — Subhas Pally, Heritage, score 9.3; theme “Monumental Heritage Pavilion & Cultural Carnival”
7. [Rathkhola Sporting Club](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/rathkhola-sporting-club) — Rathkhola, Theme, score 9.2; theme “Tradition Meets Innovation in Subhas Pally Corridor”
8. [Amtala Yuba Samity](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/amtala-yuba-samity) — Ashrampara, Traditional, score 9.1; theme “Traditional Rajbari Pratima & Sacred Chandi Path”

Home to some of the year’s top-scoring theme pandals. Burdwan Road and Church Road are the main approaches; several pujas here run strict pedestrian cordons in the evening.

Pujas around Siliguri Junction, Matigara and the outer west are convenient if you are staying near the station or arriving by NH10.

## How to combine zones in one evening

1. Pick one main zone and one neighbouring zone — never more than two.
2. Visit the outer zone first in daylight (4–6 PM) when roads are still moving.
3. Finish in a walkable cluster after dark, when vehicles slow to a crawl.
4. Use the [route planner](https://durgapujapandal.site/siliguri-puja-routes) to order the stops automatically.

### FAQs
**Which zone has the most pandals on the Siliguri pandal map?**
Central Siliguri — the Babupara, Hakimpara, Mahananda Para and Hill Cart Road belt — has the largest number of pandals and is best explored on foot.

**Can I cover all Siliguri zones in one day?**
Not comfortably. Most visitors cover one or two zones per evening. Spread the five zones across Shashti to Navami for a relaxed Pujo.

**Which zone is best for families with a car?**
North Siliguri and parts of the west have wider roads and more pandals with parking than the crowded centre.

**Is the zone-wise pandal map updated for 2026?**
Yes. Every pandal uses its 2026 venue coordinates, and the lists on this page update automatically from the live pandal data.

## Durga Puja Pandal Map 2026: Best Walking Clusters in Siliguri
https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/durga-puja-pandal-map-2026-walking-routes · Updated 2026-10-09 · Pujo Pandal Siliguri Desk

Three walkable pandal clusters where dozens of pujas sit within a short stroll — with maps, loop order and walking tips.

On the **Durga Puja pandal map 2026**, Siliguri’s centre looks crowded with pins — and that is good news if you walk. In the core around Babupara, more than thirty pandals sit within about 750 metres of each other. On foot you skip barricades, parking hunts and one-way diversions.

- Walking loops: 3
- Pandals per evening: 4–6
- Walk between pandals: ~10 min
- Best start time: Before 6 PM

> **Rule of thumb** Plan about 10 minutes of walking plus 30–40 minutes of viewing per pandal. Four to six pandals make a comfortable evening.

## Loop 1: Babupara & Mahananda Para core

The densest cluster on the map, between Hill Cart Road and the Mahananda. Start near Venus More and work outwards so you finish close to the main road for an auto home.

1. [Babupara Sarbojanin Durga Puja](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/babupara-club-sarbojanin) — Babupara, Theme, score 9.5; theme “Terracotta Echoes of Bengal — Architectural Heritage”; 0.1 km away
2. [Dada Bhai Sporting Club](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/dada-bhai-sporting-club) — Deshbandhupara, Theme, score 9.5; theme “Grand Heritage Pavilion & Artisanal Splendor”; 0.2 km away
3. [Babupara YMA Club](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/babupara-yma-club) — Babupara, Theme, score 9.4; theme “Grand Heritage Architecture & Palace Replicas”; 0.0 km away
4. [Rabindra Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/rabindra-sangha) — Hakimpara, Heritage, score 9.4; theme “Tagore's Shantiniketan Aesthetic & Cultural Harmony”; 0.4 km away
5. [Arunoday Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/arunoday-sangha) — Hakimpara, Theme, score 9.1; theme “Temple Architecture of Ancient Bengal”; 0.4 km away
6. [Sanghashree Club](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/sanghashree-club) — Subhas Pally, Heritage, score 9.1; theme “Classical Temple Pavilion & Devotional Dhunuchi Dance”; 0.2 km away
7. [Kachari Road Yubak Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/kachari-road-yubak-sangha) — Siliguri Town, Heritage, score 9; theme “Heritage Judiciary & Rule of Dharma”; 0.4 km away
8. [Nava Jagriti Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/nava-jagriti-sangha) — Siliguri Town, Traditional, score 9; theme “Golden Bengal — Handcrafted Sholapith Architecture”; 0.6 km away

## Loop 2: Hakimpara & Ashrampara

Narrow residential lanes with some of the city’s most respected traditional pujas, including Hakimpara Yuvak Sangha. Vehicles are restricted in many lanes, so this loop is walking-only in the evening.

1. [Hakimpara Yuvak Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/hakimpara-yuvak-sangha) — Hakimpara, Traditional, score 9.6; theme “Sabeki Ekchala Traditional Rajbari Pujo”; 0.1 km away
2. [Jatiya Tarun Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/jatiya-tarun-sangha) — Ashrampara, Theme, score 9.4; theme “Illumination Wonders & Contemporary Art”; 0.2 km away
3. [Rabindra Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/rabindra-sangha) — Hakimpara, Heritage, score 9.4; theme “Tagore's Shantiniketan Aesthetic & Cultural Harmony”; 0.3 km away
4. [Amtala Yuba Samity](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/amtala-yuba-samity) — Ashrampara, Traditional, score 9.1; theme “Traditional Rajbari Pratima & Sacred Chandi Path”; 0.1 km away
5. [Arunoday Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/arunoday-sangha) — Hakimpara, Theme, score 9.1; theme “Temple Architecture of Ancient Bengal”; 0.3 km away
6. [Ramkrishna Byam Siksha Samiti](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/ramkrishna-byam-siksha-samiti) — Hakimpara, Traditional, score 9.1; theme “Strength & Spirituality — Swami Vivekananda's Call”; 0.4 km away
7. [Kachari Road Yubak Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/kachari-road-yubak-sangha) — Siliguri Town, Heritage, score 9; theme “Heritage Judiciary & Rule of Dharma”; 0.4 km away
8. [Udayan Samiti](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/udayan-samiti) — Hakimpara, Traditional, score 9; theme “Dawn of Knowledge — The Upanishadic Path”; 0.3 km away

## Loop 3: Deshbandhupara, Subhas Pally & Shaktigarh

The southern loop is home to several of the year’s top theme pandals. Approach from Church Road or Burdwan Road and expect police pedestrian corridors after 6 PM.

1. [Shaktigarh Sarbajanin Durga Utsav](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/shaktigarh-sarbajanin-durga-utsav) — Shaktigarh, Theme, score 9.6; theme “Uttareshwar (Hawa Mahal-inspired architecture)”; 0.4 km away
2. [Subrata Sangha Durgapuja Committee](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/subrata-sangha-durgapuja-committee) — Deshbandhupara, Theme, score 9.5; theme “Elaborate Design-Led Theme & Artisanal Pavilion”; 0.2 km away
3. [Deshbandhupara Friends Union](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/deshbandhupara-sarbojanin) — Deshbandhupara, Traditional, score 9.4; theme “Heritage Bell Metal (Kansa) Craft of Bengal”; 0.3 km away
4. [Baghajatin Park Durgotsab Committee](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/baghajatin-park-durgotsab-committee) — Subhas Pally, Heritage, score 9.3; theme “Monumental Heritage Pavilion & Cultural Carnival”; 0.4 km away
5. [Ujjwal Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/ujjwal-sangha) — Shaktigarh, Theme, score 9.3; theme “Ram Mandir of Ayodhya (73rd Milestone Year)”; 0.6 km away
6. [Milanpally Sarbojanin Durga Puja Committee](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/milanpally-sarbojanin-durga-puja-committee) — Milanpally, Heritage, score 9.2; theme “Heritage Silk Weaves & Tant of Bengal”; 0.5 km away
7. [Rathkhola Sporting Club](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/rathkhola-sporting-club) — Rathkhola, Theme, score 9.2; theme “Tradition Meets Innovation in Subhas Pally Corridor”; 0.1 km away
8. [Swastika Yubak Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/swastika-yubak-sangha) — Mahananda Para, Theme, score 9.1; theme “Classical Temple Craft & Festive Illumination”; 0.2 km away

## Walking tips for Pujo nights

- Wear comfortable, closed shoes — lanes get crowded and uneven.
- Carry water and a small power bank; you will use the map a lot.
- Fix a meeting point (a sweet shop or a pandal gate) in case your group splits.
- Walk against the main crowd flow where you can; queues move faster in the first hour after opening.
- Use the [route planner](https://durgapujapandal.site/siliguri-puja-routes) in Walking mode to get an ordered loop from your exact start point.

### FAQs
**Which is the best area in Siliguri for pandal hopping on foot?**
The Babupara and Mahananda Para core near Hill Cart Road has the most pandals within walking distance, followed by Hakimpara–Ashrampara and the Deshbandhupara–Shaktigarh belt.

**How many pandals can I walk to in one evening?**
Four to six pandals is comfortable, allowing around 10 minutes of walking and 30–40 minutes at each pandal.

**Are vehicles allowed near central Siliguri pandals?**
Many central lanes become pedestrian-only in the evening, and some pandals are strictly walk-in. Park at the edge of the cluster and walk in.

**Does the walking route open in Google Maps?**
Yes. Build a route in Walking mode and tap Start Navigation — Google Maps opens in walking mode with all your stops.

## Bike or car?

|  | Bike / scooty | Car / auto |
|---|---|---|
| Speed in traffic | Fast, can filter through slow traffic | Slow after 6 PM in the centre |
| Parking | Small bays near most pandals | Only at pandals with grounds |
| Best zones | Sevoke Road corridor, East, South | North, West, outer pujas |
| Best for | Pairs, young groups | Families, elders, rain |

## Driving tips for Pujo

- Do outer pandals by vehicle in the afternoon, then park once and walk the centre.
- Keep helmets on and headlights clean — crowds spill onto roads after dark.
- Follow the diversion boards; one-way rules change on the main Pujo days.
- Check advisories from the Siliguri Metropolitan Police before heading out.
- In the [route planner](https://durgapujapandal.site/siliguri-puja-routes), choose Bike or Car — parking time is added to every stop.

### FAQs
**Which Siliguri pandals have parking in 2026?**
38 pandals list parking near the venue on the 2026 map. The list on this page shows the top-rated ones; filter by “Parking available” on the pandals page for the full set.

**Can I drive into central Siliguri during Durga Puja?**
You can reach the edges, but many central lanes become pedestrian-only in the evening. Park at the edge and walk the final stretch.

**Is bike or car better for pandal hopping in Siliguri?**
A bike or scooty is quicker for covering several zones; a car suits families and outer pandals with grounds. In the centre, walking beats both after 6 PM.

**Does Google Maps open in two-wheeler mode?**
Yes. When you build a Bike / Scooty route, Google Maps opens in two-wheeler mode where it is available.

## How to Use the Durga Puja Pandal Map 2026 on Your Phone
https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/how-to-use-durga-puja-pandal-map-2026 · Updated 2026-10-09 · Pujo Pandal Siliguri Desk

A step-by-step phone guide — search, filter, directions, saving pandals, building a route and staying online in crowds.

The **Durga Puja pandal map 2026** is built for phones first. You do not need an app — open it in any browser. Here is how to get the most out of it in a few minutes.

- Works on: Any phone browser
- Time to learn: About a minute
- Saved pandals: Stored on your phone
- Offline backup: Google Maps offline area

## Step by step

1. **Open the map.** Go to the [Siliguri Puja map](https://durgapujapandal.site/siliguri-puja-map). All 83 pandals appear as numbered pins showing their score.
2. **Search.** Type a pandal name, area or theme — for example “Hakimpara” or “terracotta”.
3. **Filter.** Pick a neighbourhood from the area menu, or tap Top Theme, Traditional, Parking or Verified.
4. **Tap a pin.** See the theme, visit time and parking status, then open the full pandal page.
5. **Get directions.** Tap Directions to open Google Maps with the pandal as your destination.
6. **Save it.** Tap the bookmark icon. Your list appears under [Saved](https://durgapujapandal.site/saved) and stays on your phone.
7. **Build a route.** Use the [route planner](https://durgapujapandal.site/siliguri-puja-routes) to order several pandals from your start point.

## Using “Near me”

Tap **Near Me** in the header and allow location access. The planner can then start your route from where you are standing, and Google Maps opens straight into navigation from your live GPS position.

## Staying connected in big crowds

- Mobile data often slows near the biggest pandals. Save your pandals before you leave home.
- In Google Maps, download Siliguri as an offline area so turn-by-turn directions still work.
- Take a screenshot of your route timeline as a backup.
- Keep a power bank — maps and cameras drain batteries quickly on Pujo nights.

## Share your plan with family

After building a route, tap **Share Route** to send the list of pandals and the Google Maps link on WhatsApp. Everyone in the group can then follow the same order.

[Try the map now](https://durgapujapandal.site/siliguri-puja-map)

### FAQs
**Do I need to install an app for the Durga Puja pandal map 2026?**
No. The map runs in any phone browser. You can add it to your home screen from the browser menu for quicker access.

**Where are my saved pandals stored?**
Saved pandals are stored privately on your own phone in the browser. They are not uploaded anywhere.

**Why does the map ask for my location?**
Only to show pandals near you and to start routes from your position. It works fine without location access — just pick a starting point instead.

**Can I share a pandal route on WhatsApp?**
Yes. Use Share Route after building a route to send the pandal list and Google Maps link.

The highest-rated theme pandals of 2026 — what each one is about, where it is on the map and when to go.

Theme pandals are the showstoppers of Siliguri’s Pujo — giant facades, art installations and light shows that draw the biggest crowds. The **Durga Puja pandal map 2026** lists 28 theme pandals this year. These are the top-rated ones, with their themes and practical notes.

## When to see theme pandals without the crush

- **Shashti evening or Saptami afternoon** — lights are on, crowds have not peaked yet.
- **Early on Ashtami morning** — many people are at anjali in their local para.
- Avoid **Navami night** for the biggest names unless you enjoy the crowd itself.

## Photography tips

- Go just after dusk for the best mix of sky and lighting.
- Shoot facades from across the road; inside, focus on details like the pratima’s eyes and ornaments.
- Respect queue volunteers — many pandals do not allow stopping inside the sanctum.

> **Plan a theme-only evening** In the [route planner](https://durgapujapandal.site/siliguri-puja-routes), choose **Top Themes** as your goal — it gives extra viewing time at the big installations.

### FAQs
**Which is the best theme pandal in Siliguri in 2026?**
The list on this page ranks theme pandals by their 2026 pandal score. The top names change as reviews come in, so the list updates automatically.

**How long should I spend at a theme pandal?**
Plan 40–50 minutes for the biggest theme pandals, including the queue. Smaller theme pujas take about 30 minutes.

**Are theme pandals in Siliguri open in the afternoon?**
Most are open from the afternoon, but lighting effects are best after dusk. Afternoon visits usually have shorter queues.

**Can I see several theme pandals in one evening?**
Yes, if you stay within one zone. Use the zone-wise pandal map or the route planner with the Top Themes goal.

## Traditional & Heritage Pujas on the Durga Puja Pandal Map 2026
https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/traditional-heritage-pujas-durga-puja-pandal-map-2026 · Updated 2026-10-09 · Pujo Pandal Siliguri Desk

Where to find ekchala pratima, daaker saaj and classic rituals in Siliguri — and when to time your visit.

Not every Pujo is about lights and themes. Siliguri has 18 traditional and 19 heritage pujas on the **Durga Puja pandal map 2026** — places where the pratima, the dhak and the rituals are the main attraction.

- Traditional pujas: 18
- Heritage pujas: 19
- Pushpanjali: Ashtami morning, 19 Oct
- Sandhi Puja: Ashtami–Navami juncture

## What makes a puja “traditional”?

- **Ekchala pratima** — Durga and her children under a single arched frame, the classic Bengali form.
- **Daaker saaj** — white shola-pith ornaments, once shipped “by post” (daak) from Kolkata.
- **Chalchitra** — the painted arch behind the idol showing scenes from the Puranas.
- **Dhak and kansor** at aarti, with dhunuchi dance in the evenings.

## Traditional and heritage pujas on the map

1. [Hakimpara Yuvak Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/hakimpara-yuvak-sangha) — Hakimpara, Traditional, score 9.6; theme “Sabeki Ekchala Traditional Rajbari Pujo”
2. [Deshbandhupara Friends Union](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/deshbandhupara-sarbojanin) — Deshbandhupara, Traditional, score 9.4; theme “Heritage Bell Metal (Kansa) Craft of Bengal”
3. [Rabindra Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/rabindra-sangha) — Hakimpara, Heritage, score 9.4; theme “Tagore's Shantiniketan Aesthetic & Cultural Harmony”
4. [Baghajatin Park Durgotsab Committee](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/baghajatin-park-durgotsab-committee) — Subhas Pally, Heritage, score 9.3; theme “Monumental Heritage Pavilion & Cultural Carnival”
5. [Surya Nagar Friends Union](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/surya-nagar-friends-union) — Surya Nagar, Heritage, score 9.3; theme “Rural Bengal Tapestry & Traditional Hogla Craft”
6. [Milanpally Sarbojanin Durga Puja Committee](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/milanpally-sarbojanin-durga-puja-committee) — Milanpally, Heritage, score 9.2; theme “Heritage Silk Weaves & Tant of Bengal”
7. [Amtala Yuba Samity](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/amtala-yuba-samity) — Ashrampara, Traditional, score 9.1; theme “Traditional Rajbari Pratima & Sacred Chandi Path”
8. [Bharat Sevashram Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/bharat-sevashram-sangha) — Milanpally, Heritage, score 9.1; theme “Vedic Shastric Puja & Spiritual Chanting”
9. [Ramkrishna Byam Siksha Samiti](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/ramkrishna-byam-siksha-samiti) — Hakimpara, Traditional, score 9.1; theme “Strength & Spirituality — Swami Vivekananda's Call”
10. [Sanghashree Club](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/sanghashree-club) — Subhas Pally, Heritage, score 9.1; theme “Classical Temple Pavilion & Devotional Dhunuchi Dance”
11. [Bandhab Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/bandhab-sangha) — College Para, Traditional, score 9; theme “Classical Sabeki Pujo & Youth Cultural Fest”
12. [Kachari Road Yubak Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/kachari-road-yubak-sangha) — Siliguri Town, Heritage, score 9; theme “Heritage Judiciary & Rule of Dharma”
13. [Nava Jagriti Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/nava-jagriti-sangha) — Siliguri Town, Traditional, score 9; theme “Golden Bengal — Handcrafted Sholapith Architecture”
14. [Netaji Yuba Sangha](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/netaji-yuba-sangha) — Siliguri Town, Heritage, score 9; theme “Patriotism & The Spirit of Azad Hind”
15. [Saktigarh Pathagar](https://durgapujapandal.site/pandals/saktigarh-pathagar) — Shaktigarh, Heritage, score 9; theme “The Temple of Knowledge — Books & Enlightenment”

## Rituals worth timing your visit around

| Day | Ritual | Why go |
|---|---|---|
| Saptami morning | Nabapatrika (kola bou) snan | The procession to the river ghats opens the main Puja |
| Ashtami morning | Pushpanjali | Offer anjali at a traditional para puja |
| Ashtami–Navami | Sandhi Puja | The 48-minute juncture with 108 lamps and lotuses |
| Navami evening | Dhunuchi aarti | Incense dance to the dhak |
| Dashami | Boron & sindoor khela | Farewell to the Goddess before visarjan |

Exact tithi timings are on the [Puja schedule](https://durgapujapandal.site/puja-schedule). For a day-by-day plan, see [Durga Puja 2026 dates & pandal map](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/durga-puja-2026-dates-pandal-map-day-wise-plan).

### FAQs
**Where can I see a traditional ekchala Durga idol in Siliguri?**
Traditional pujas such as those in Hakimpara and the central paras keep the ekchala form. The list on this page shows the top-rated traditional and heritage pujas on the 2026 map.

**What is daaker saaj?**
Daaker saaj is the classic white shola-pith ornamentation of the Durga idol. The name comes from “daak” (post), as the ornaments were once sent by post from Kolkata.

**When is Sandhi Puja in 2026?**
Sandhi Puja falls at the juncture of Ashtami and Navami (19–20 October 2026). Check the Puja schedule page for the exact timing.

**Are traditional pujas less crowded than theme pandals?**
Usually yes, except during anjali and Sandhi Puja, when local residents gather.

## Durga Puja 2026 Dates & Pandal Map: Day-Wise Plan for Siliguri
https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/durga-puja-2026-dates-pandal-map-day-wise-plan · Updated 2026-10-09 · Pujo Pandal Siliguri Desk

Mahalaya to Dashami: every 2026 date and which part of the pandal map to explore on each day.

Five days, 83 pandals — you cannot see everything, so match each day to the right part of the **Durga Puja pandal map 2026**. Here are the dates and a simple day-wise plan for Siliguri.

- Mahalaya: Sat, 10 Oct 2026
- Maha Shashti: Sat, 17 Oct 2026
- Maha Ashtami: Mon, 19 Oct 2026
- Vijaya Dashami: Wed, 21 Oct 2026

## Durga Puja 2026 dates

- Mahalaya: Saturday, 10 October 2026 — Invocation of Goddess Durga with dawn Chandi Path and Tarpan at Mahananda Ghat.
- Maha Shashti: Saturday, 17 October 2026 — Beginning of Devi worship with Kalparambha, Bodhan, Amantran and Adhibas.
- Maha Saptami: Sunday, 18 October 2026 — Nabapatrika Pravesh (Kola Bou Snan) at river ghats followed by Saptami Puja rituals.
- Maha Ashtami: Monday, 19 October 2026 — Morning Pushpanjali, Kumari Puja, and the sacred 48-minute Sandhi Puja transition into Navami.
- Maha Navami: Tuesday, 20 October 2026 — Navami Homa, Bhog distribution, and evening Dhunuchi dance aratis.
- Vijaya Dashami: Wednesday, 21 October 2026 — Aparajita Puja, Sindoor Khela, and Visarjan processions at Mahananda River Ghats.

## Day-wise pandal plan

### Mahalaya – 10 October

Wake up for the 4 AM Mahishasuramardini broadcast and tarpan at the Mahananda ghats. Many pandals are still being finished — a good day to watch the final touches. Read more on the [Mahalaya page](https://durgapujapandal.site/mahalaya).

### Maha Shashti – 17 October

Bodhon and the first evening of lights. Crowds are lightest — the best night for the biggest [theme pandals](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/best-theme-pandals-durga-puja-pandal-map-2026).

### Maha Saptami – 18 October

Nabapatrika snan in the morning. In the evening, cover an outer zone by vehicle, then finish in a walking cluster.

### Maha Ashtami – 19 October

Anjali in the morning and Sandhi Puja at the Ashtami–Navami juncture. Spend the day at [traditional and heritage pujas](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/traditional-heritage-pujas-durga-puja-pandal-map-2026).

### Maha Navami – 20 October

The busiest night. Stay local, walk a [central cluster](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/durga-puja-pandal-map-2026-walking-routes) and catch dhunuchi aarti.

### Vijaya Dashami – 21 October

Boron and sindoor khela in the morning, visarjan processions towards the Mahananda later in the day. Expect road closures along the procession routes.

> **Save as you go** Bookmark pandals on the map as you plan each day — your [saved plan](https://durgapujapandal.site/saved) shows total darshan time.

### FAQs
**When does Durga Puja 2026 start in Siliguri?**
Mahalaya is on 10 October 2026. The main Pujo begins on Maha Shashti, 17 October, and ends with Vijaya Dashami on 21 October 2026.

**Which day is best for pandal hopping in Siliguri?**
Shashti and Saptami evenings are less crowded. Navami night is the busiest.

**When is Sindoor Khela in 2026?**
Sindoor Khela takes place on Vijaya Dashami, 21 October 2026, before the idols leave for visarjan.

**Where does visarjan happen in Siliguri?**
Processions head towards the Mahananda river ghats. Expect diversions on the main roads during the afternoon and evening of Dashami.

---

Pandals with parking and short visits, plus practical tips for going out with children and elders.

Pujo with grandparents or small children needs a different plan: less walking, shorter queues and somewhere to park. These family-friendly pandals on the **Durga Puja pandal map 2026** combine parking with visits of about 35 minutes or less.

## Tips for Pujo with children and elders

- Go between **3 PM and 6 PM** — daylight, shorter queues and easier parking.
- Put a card with your phone number in each child’s pocket.
- Fix a meeting point at every pandal before you enter.
- Carry water, a light snack and a folding stool or umbrella for elders.
- Choose 3–4 pandals rather than chasing the famous names in peak crowds.

## Build a family route

In the [route planner](https://durgapujapandal.site/siliguri-puja-routes), pick **Car / Auto** and the **Family Friendly** goal. It favours pandals with parking and shorter visits, and adds parking time to every stop. The ready-made [North Junction Family Express](https://durgapujapandal.site/routes/north-junction-family-express) circuit is another easy option.

### FAQs
**Which pandals in Siliguri are best for families?**
Pandals with parking and shorter visit times, especially in North Siliguri and around wider roads. The list on this page is filtered for exactly that.

**What time is best for pandal hopping with kids?**
Late afternoon, between about 3 PM and 6 PM, before the evening crowds peak.

**Are Siliguri pandals wheelchair accessible?**
Access varies. Pandals with open grounds are usually easier; check each pandal’s access notes on its page before visiting.

**Is there a ready-made family route?**
Yes — the North Junction Family Express circuit focuses on wide approach roads and parking hubs.

### FAQs
**Which Durga Puja pandal is closest to NJP station?**
The list on this page ranks pandals by distance from NJP. Central Colony and South Colony pujas are among the closest.

**Can I visit pandals during a train layover in Siliguri?**
Yes, with 3–4 hours you can comfortably visit two or three pandals near NJP or Siliguri Junction by toto or auto.

**How far is central Siliguri from NJP?**
Central Siliguri (Hill Cart Road and Babupara) is roughly 5–6 km from NJP. In Pujo traffic, allow 30–45 minutes each way.

**Is there a pandal near Siliguri Junction?**
Yes. Several Pradhannagar and Siliguri Town pujas are within about a kilometre of Siliguri Junction.
